commentary.text: 90+11' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+11' Tottenham work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
90+10' Timo Werner (Tottenham) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Aston Villa.
90+9' Diego Carlos (Aston Villa) was too forceful with his tackle and Chris Kavanagh interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
90+7' Rodrigo Bentancur (Tottenham) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.
90+7' A raking crossfield pass from Yves Bissouma (Tottenham) lacks accuracy and the opposition gain possession.

90+4' 0 - 4 GOAL! Superb work from Heung-Min Son, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Timo Werner (Tottenham), who beats Emiliano Martinez with a brilliant shot into the right side of the net. 0:4.
90+1' 0 - 3 Goal! Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) finds himself some space inside the box to get on the end of a pass from Dejan Kulusevski, then sends the ball into the roof of the net. 0:3.
90' The fourth official shows 10 min. of added time.
90' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) takes the corner with a short pass.
90' A first-time shot by Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) inside the box is unwittingly blocked by one of his own players.
88' Here comes a substitution. Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg (Tottenham) is brought on as a substitute for Brennan Johnson.
87' Here is a change. James Maddison is going off and Ange Postecoglou gives the last tactical orders to Timo Werner (Tottenham).
86' The resulting corner from Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
85' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Ezri Konsa as he is replaced by Diego Carlos (Aston Villa).
84' Nicolo Zaniolo (Aston Villa) wins himself enough space to meet the resulting corner and fires the ball at goal, but the keeper does well to stop his effort.
84' Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
84' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Moussa Diaby (Aston Villa), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
84' Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
84' Moussa Diaby (Aston Villa) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Aston Villa force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
82' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
81' Tottenham are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
77' The foul by Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) was seen by Chris Kavanagh who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
76' The resulting corner, taken by Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa), comes to nothing.

76' Matty Cash (Aston Villa) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Aston Villa.
74' The total number of attempts is 7:3.
70' Ange Postecoglou prepares a substitution. Pape Matar Sarr is replaced by Rodrigo Bentancur (Tottenham).
69' That will be all from Leon Bailey who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Tim Iroegbunam (Aston Villa).
69' The linesman raises his flag. Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) is adjudged offside.
65' John McGinn (Aston Villa) is sent off after deserving nothing other than a red card from a referee for clattering into his opponent!
65' Half-chance! John McGinn (Aston Villa) plays a pass into the box, but Guglielmo Vicario reacts well to snuff out the attack.
61' Radu Dragusin (Tottenham) is yellow-carded.
61' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) works the corner short.
58' The referee signals a substitution. Nicolo Zaniolo (Aston Villa) is brought on as a substitute for Youri Tielemans.
58' Unai Emery has decided to make a change. Moussa Diaby (Aston Villa) replaces Clement Lenglet.
58' Substitution. Lucas Digne leaves the pitch and is replaced by Alex Moreno (Aston Villa).

53' 0 - 2 Goal! Heung-Min Son displays great vision and sends a pass to Brennan Johnson (Tottenham), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball into the top of the net. The score is 0:2.
52' Here comes the VAR decision. The goal is given and Tottenham players have a reason to celebrate!
51' The Tottenham players halt their celebrations as referee Chris Kavanagh makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
50' 0 - 1 Goal! Pape Matar Sarr passes the ball to the feet of James Maddison (Tottenham), who has an empty net in front of him and has no problems in tapping the ball in. 0:1.
50' Micky van de Ven is being substituted because of an injury. Ange Postecoglou sends Radu Dragusin (Tottenham) on the pitch.
49' Micky van de Ven (Tottenham) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
48' Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) is flagged for offside.
46' This shall not pass! Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+1' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) latches onto a lofted pass near the penalty spot, but sends his header miles wide of the right post.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
45' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender.
44' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat.
42' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) latches onto the ball after a scramble in the box, but his placed effort towards the bottom left corner is far too weak and Emiliano Martinez makes a simple save.
41' Rough tackle by Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
38' John McGinn (Aston Villa) jumps into a tackle and Chris Kavanagh signals a foul.

36' James Maddison (Tottenham) latches on to the corner kick and releases a quick strike from the edge of the box. The result differs significantly from his intention as the ball flies way over the crossbar.
35' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
35' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger. The referee signals a corner kick to Tottenham.
33' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
32' Chris Kavanagh blows his whistle and signals a foul after Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) brought his opponent down.
29' Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted.
27' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman.
26' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) sends a chip pass into the box, but Emiliano Martinez is quickest to intercept the ball.
24' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) sends a cross into the box, but Guglielmo Vicario comes off his line to gather the ball.
23' Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.

22' John McGinn (Aston Villa) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. The referee points to the corner flag and Aston Villa will take a corner.
19' Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
18' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Pedro Porro (Tottenham), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
17' Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
15' Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.
13' The ratio of the ball possession is 23:77.
12' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent.
10' Destiny Udogie (Tottenham) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Dejan Kulusevski, but he can't get on the end of the pass.
8' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) makes a rough challenge and Chris Kavanagh blows his whistle for a foul.

7' The cross into the penalty area from Pedro Porro (Tottenham) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team. The ball goes out of play and Aston Villa will have a goal kick.
5' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
5' PENALTY APPEAL after Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
4' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) is penalised for holding. Chris Kavanagh signals a set piece.
1' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
